name: YouTube Media for Discord VC
description: Stream the audio of any YouTube media (music, videos, podcasts) into a Discord voice channel via yt-dlp — real audio, not TTS. Ducks for AI speech and auto-resumes.

accountId.description: Discord account id whose voice connection to reuse (default: default). The plugin plays into the openclaw:<accountId> voice connection group.

cookiesPath.description: Netscape cookie jar path inside the container (default /root/.openclaw/credentials/youtube-cookies.txt). Optional — without cookies, only freely available media plays.

cookiesCommand.description: Optional shell command that prints a fresh Netscape cookie jar to stdout (e.g. a password-manager reader script). When set, the jar is refreshed at load and when older than 6h. When unset, cookiesPath is used as-is if present.

ytDlpPath.description: yt-dlp binary (default: yt-dlp on PATH). Its directory is prepended to PATH for child processes.

ffmpegPath.description: ffmpeg binary with libopus (default: ffmpeg on PATH). Used to transcode to Ogg/Opus for Discord.
